messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your healthcare provider about severe pain, swelling, or skin changes.
These symptoms occur where the injection was given.
In rare cases, the injection has caused serious damage to the surrounding tissue.
The damage included tissue death (necrosis) and gangrene.
The damage has needed surgery to treat.
This is not a complete list of side effects.
Others may happen.
Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects.
You may report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Triplet: ["hydroxyzine", "has treatment for side effect", "surgery"]

The relation 'has treatment for side effect' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug's adverse effect is treated or managed by the medical intervention specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'applies to patients who are to be managed with': The subject drug is used for patients who are managed with the procedure or treatment specified by the object entity.
C. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'has related treatment guide': The subject drug is associated with the medical treatment guide specified by the object entity.
E. 'used after': The subject drug is used following the treatment or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
